sentences.text:
Reliance General Insurance Company Ltd vs Manjula Kabiraj
Das on 21 July, 2023

Bench: C.T. Ravikumar, Sanjay Kumar
 Item No.35 Court No.16 Section Ix
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Special Leave Petition (Civil) Diary No.26919/2023
 (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 17-03-2023
 in Fa No. 180/2023 passed by the High Court of Judicature at
 Bombay)
 Reliance General Insurance Company Ltd. Petitioner(s)
 Versus
 Manjula Kabiraj Das & Ors. Respondent(s)
 (For Admission and I.R. and Ia No.130554/2023-CONDONATION Of Delay
 In Filing )
 Date : 21-07-2023
This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.T. RAVIKUMAR

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Atul Nanda, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Abhimanyu Walia, Adv.
 Mr. Martand Singh, Adv.
 Ms. Prerna Mehta, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Delay condoned.
Issue notice, limited on the question whether the amount covered by ex gratia could be deducted from the compensation assessed under the head Pay and Allowances, while determining compensation under Motor Vehicles Act, in view of the decision reported in 2016 (9) SCC 627,
returnable in six weeks.
In the meanwhile, the petitioner shall deposit the amount awarded by the Tribunal before the Tribunal within a period of four weeks.
Once the amount is deposited, it will be open to the claimants to withdraw the amounts except the amount covered by ex gratia as mentioned above, on proper application.
